def format_line(item: LineItem, width: int = WIDTH) -> str:
    """One receipt line: the SKU on the left, quantity and amount on the right."""
    if width < 20:
        raise ValueError("width must be at least 20")
    name = item.sku.strip()
    if not name:
        name = "(no sku)"
    amount = item.total.quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    if item.quantity > 1:
        right = f"{item.quantity} x {item.unit_price:.2f} = {amount:.2f}"
    else:
        right = f"{amount:.2f}"
    room = width - len(right) - 1
    if room < 4:
        right = f"{amount:.2f}"
        room = width - len(right) - 1
    if len(name) > room:
        name = name[: room - 1] + "~"
    padding = width - len(name) - len(right)
    return name + " " * padding + right

def format_total(label: str, amount: Decimal, width: int = WIDTH) -> str:
    """A totals line: the label on the left, the amount on the right, a negative amount in brackets."""
    value = Decimal(amount).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    if value < 0:
        text = f"({-value:.2f})"
    else:
        text = f"{value:.2f}"
    label = label.strip().upper()
    if not label:
        label = "TOTAL"
    room = width - len(text) - 1
    if len(label) > room:
        label = label[:room]
    padding = width - len(label) - len(text)
    return label + " " * padding + text

def format_line(item: LineItem, width: int = WIDTH) -> str:
    """One receipt line: the SKU on the left, quantity and amount on the right."""
    if width < 20:
        raise ValueError("width must be at least 20")
    name = item.sku.strip()
    if not name:
        name = "(no sku)"
    amount = item.total.quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    if item.quantity > 1:
        right = f"{item.quantity} x {item.unit_price:.2f} = {amount:.2f}"
    else:
        right = f"{amount:.2f}"
    room = width - len(right) - 1
    if room < 4:
        right = f"{amount:.2f}"
        room = width - len(right) - 1
    if len(name) > room:
        name = name[: room - 1] + "~"
    padding = width - len(name) - len(right)
    return name + " " * padding + right

def format_total(label: str, amount: Decimal, width: int = WIDTH) -> str:
    """A totals line: the label on the left, the amount on the right, a negative amount in brackets."""
    value = Decimal(amount).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    if value < 0:
        text = f"({-value:.2f})"
    else:
        text = f"{value:.2f}"
    label = label.strip().upper()
    if not label:
        label = "TOTAL"
    room = width - len(text) - 1
    if len(label) > room:
        label = label[:room]
    padding = width - len(label) - len(text)
    return label + " " * padding + text
